Patch Test: Test on a small patch of skin 24 hours prior to full use to check for adverse reactions.
Apply: Spread an even, generous layer over the hair without rubbing it in.
Wait: Leave on for the package-specified time (usually 3 to 6 minutes; do not exceed the maximum time, typically 6 to 10 minutes).
Remove & Rinse: Wipe away the cream and hair with a soft cloth or spatula, then rinse the skin thoroughly with water.

Wait Between Uses: Wait at least 72 hours between applications on the same area.
Note: Avoid using standard body hair creams on the face, scalp, or broken/sunburnt skin unless specifically formulated for those sensitive zones.
